home_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one original polished 16:9 Japanese website homepage proposal for 田村ふとん店, Kyoto bedding shop. Wide canvas with large desktop homepage at left and clearly readable narrow responsive smartphone preview at right. Quiet ivory, indigo and muted gold; sophisticated airy typography. Actual confirmed business sells 京真綿, 手作り敷きふとん and bedding consultation. Header 田村ふとん店. Main heading 「寝具のご相談を、身近に。」 Small service cards 「京真綿」「手作り敷きふとん」「寝具のご相談」. Primary visible button 「お問い合わせ」. Contact section shows 「075-451-2165」 and 「京都市上京区革堂前之町110」. Main fictional photograph folded plain quilts and cotton texture, no actual staff or store portrayal. Mobile layout must wrap navigation/content within screen, full-width contact button and vertical cards. This is a proposal for fixing mobile horizontal overflow in inquiry flow. Do not invent benefits, health outcomes, prices, delivery promises, promotions, awards or opening hours. Keep all Japanese sharp readable, unclipped. Bottom caption verbatim 「非公式のデザイン案です。写真はイメージです。」
inquiry_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a separate original 16:9 Japanese inquiry-page proposal for 田村ふとん店. Reference image is style reference only: keep ivory, indigo, restrained gold, elegant readable Japanese. Desktop inquiry page left and large narrow smartphone preview right. Fix verified mobile problem: all labels and inputs vertically stacked within screen, no sideways overflow. Main title お問い合わせ. Header 田村ふとん店. Telephone alternative 075-451-2165. Form clearly shows お名前（必須）, メールアドレス（必須）, メールアドレスの確認（必須）, フリガナ（任意）, 電話番号（任意）, お問い合わせ項目（必須） with choices お問合せ・来店予約・その他, お問い合わせ内容. No filled personal information. Primary button 入力内容を確認する. Footer 京都市上京区革堂前之町110. Preserve existing form concept; do not claim sent/completed or invent turnaround, health claims, prices. Small subtle cotton/quilting illustrative photograph, not actual store. Make smartphone labels and full-width input boxes readable and entirely visible; optional lower form content can continue vertically. Prominent bottom caption exactly 非公式のデザイン案です。写真はイメージです。
